description:
This video tells the story of the Transformer, the architecture behind ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and much of modern AI. It explains why older language models struggled with long text, how attention changed everything, and why the 2017 paper Attention Is All You Need became such a turning point. You’ll also learn how a small group of Google researchers accidentally helped create the foundation for today’s biggest AI companies.

Video created by @aniakubow
